Name: Pierre Shopcreeper (Fake Smile Pierre) (CP)
Author: Molenfeuer
Description:
Does it make you angry that Pierre nicely smiles at you while you're talking to him, even though he is a proven liar and crook? Well here comes the solution! This mod adds a fake smile to his facial expressions.
[size=5][b]
Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Download the newest version of this mod from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/96969738?tab=user+files]NexusMods[/url] or the GitHub [url=https://github.com/Molenfeuer/PierreShopcreeper/releases]release page[/url]﻿
[*]Extract the ZIP-File and put the folder into the mods folder of SMAPI (mostly located under "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods")
[/list][b][size=5]
Features[/size][/b][list]
[*]Give Pierre a creepy fake smile to fit his facial expression to his character
[/list][b][size=5]
Contribute[/size][/b]
If something doesn't work, or you miss a feature, feel free to open a new issue on the [url=https://github.com/Molenfeuer/PierreShopcreeper/issues]GitHub Page of this mod[/url]. I prefer the GitHub Page but if you really don't want to use it feel free to use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9915?tab=bugs]Issue Page here on NexusMods[/url].
